game_rules.spellblade: Trinity Force, Divine Sunderer, Lich Bane, Essence Reaver, Iceborn Gauntlet — pick ONE, they don't stack
game_rules.lifeline: Sterak's Gage, Maw of Malmortius, Phantom Dancer — pick ONE, they don't stack
game_rules.crit_onhit: Infinity Edge anti-synergy with Guinsoo's Rageblade — never build together
game_rules.anti_armor: Serylda's Grudge, Lord Dominik's Regards, Mortal Reminder — pick ONE anti-armor item
game_rules.slots: Standard: 1 boots + 5 items = 6. Support: 1 support item + 1 boots + 4 items = 6

items.name: Axiom Arc
items.passive: Flux: Champion takedowns within 3s refund 15% (+2% per 10 Armor Pen) of ultimate total CD. ARAM exclusive.

items.name: Black Cleaver
items.passive: Sunder: Physical damage reduces target armor by 6% per stack (max 4 = 24%). Chase: AAs grant MS; bonus MS toward max-stacked targets.
items.passive_brief: AAs reduce target armor by 5% per stack (max 30%).
items.passive_full: Carve: Dealing physical damage to an enemy champion reduces their armor by 5% per stack, stacking up to 6 times for a maximum of 30% armor reduction. Stacks last 6 seconds.

graph_edges.context: Cleaver shred + Serylda's %pen = maximum armor reduction

items.name: Blade of the Ruined King
items.passive: Thirst: +10% Omnivamp. Ruined Strikes: AAs deal 10%/8.5% current HP on-hit (min 15, max 60 vs monsters). Drain: 3 hits steal 25% MS (60s CD).
items.passive_brief: AAs deal 9% current HP on-hit. Siphon steals MS.
items.passive_full: Auto-attacks deal 9% of the target's current HP as bonus physical damage on-hit (max 60 vs monsters). Siphon: Attacks steal movement speed from the target for 2 seconds.

graph_edges.context: BotRK %current HP shreds Warmog's massive HP pool
BotRK on-hit + Guinsoo's every-3rd-AA double proc

items.name: Bloodthirster
items.passive: Bloody: +8% Physical Vamp (crit attacks +4%). Ichorshield: Overhealing creates shield.
items.passive_brief: 18% Lifesteal. Overheal creates a shield.
items.passive_full: Bloodlust: Gain 18% lifesteal. Ichorshield: Healing that exceeds your max HP is converted into a shield (up to 10% max HP) that decays after 15 seconds out of combat.

graph_edges.context: Lifesteal partially offsets GW but still reduced

items.name: Chempunk Chainsword
items.passive: Punishment: Physical damage applies 50% Grievous Wounds for 3s.
items.passive_brief: Physical damage applies 40% Grievous Wounds.
items.passive_full: Hackshorn: Dealing physical damage to enemy champions applies 40% Grievous Wounds for 3 seconds, reducing all healing received. Enhanced to 60% on targets below 50% HP.

graph_edges.context: GW cuts Aatrox R healing amplification

items.name: Death's Dance
items.passive: Cauterize: 27%/12% damage taken becomes bleed over 4s. Defy: Takedowns cleanse bleed and heal 8% max HP over 2s.
items.passive_brief: 30% damage taken becomes bleed over 3s. Takedowns cleanse bleed + heal.
items.passive_full: Ignore Pain: 30% of all damage taken is dealt as a bleed effect over 3 seconds instead of immediately. Defy: Champion takedowns cleanse the remaining bleed and heal you for 10% of your max HP over 2 seconds.

graph_edges.context: DD bleed + Sterak's Lifeline = double anti-burst layers
DD bleed keeps you at low HP = permanent Last Stand bonus

items.name: Divine Sunderer
items.passive: Spellblade: After ability, next AA deals 10%/7% target max HP bonus damage (min 125% base AD). Heals for 6%/2.5% target max HP. Limited to 1 Spellblade.
items.passive_brief: After ability, next AA deals bonus %max HP damage and heals.
items.passive_full: Spellblade: After using an ability, your next auto-attack within 10 seconds deals bonus damage equal to 8% of the target's max HP as physical damage and heals you for the same amount (min 150% base AD). Cooldown: 1.5 seconds.

graph_edges.context: Spellblade passives don't stack — pick ONE

items.name: Duskblade of Draktharr
items.passive: Razor: +18 Armor Pen. Nightstalker: Next AA on champion deals 60-160 bonus damage and slows 99% for 0.35s (10s CD, reset on takedown).
items.passive_brief: Damage unseen targets for bonus damage + slow.
items.passive_full: Nightstalker: When you are unseen by the target, your first auto-attack or ability deals bonus physical damage and slows the target by 30% for 0.5 seconds. Cooldown: 15 seconds per target.

graph_edges.context: Duskblade + Youmuu's = full lethality burst stack

items.name: Eclipse
items.passive: Ever Rising Moon: 2 hits on champion within 1.8s deals 7%/3.5% max HP bonus damage, grants shield (140/70 + 35%/18% bonus AD) for 2s (6s CD).
items.passive_brief: 2 hits grant shield + bonus MS + %HP damage.
items.passive_full: Ever Rising Moon: Hitting an enemy champion with 2 separate attacks or abilities within 1.5 seconds deals bonus physical damage equal to 6% of their max HP, grants you a shield (90 + 40% bonus AD) for 2 seconds, and grants 15% bonus movement speed for 2 seconds. Cooldown: 6 seconds per target.

graph_edges.context: Eclipse proc + Serylda slow = sticky bruiser assassin

items.name: Edge of Night
items.passive: Gouge: +8 Armor Pen. Annul: Grants spell shield blocking next enemy ability.
items.passive_brief: Active: Spell shield that blocks one enemy ability.
items.passive_full: Night's Veil (Active): Channel for 1.5 seconds to gain a spell shield that blocks the next enemy ability. Shield lasts until broken or for 5 seconds. Cooldown: 40 seconds.

graph_edges.context: Spell shield blocks Lux Q binding
Spell shield blocks Ahri E charm

items.name: Essence Reaver
items.passive: Spellblade: Ability casts stack (max 3). AAs consume stack for 90% AD bonus damage + 40 MS. Mana Siphon: AAs restore 3% missing mana. Limited to 1 Spellblade.
items.passive_brief: After ability, next AA deals bonus damage + restores mana.
items.passive_full: Spellblade: After using an ability, your next auto-attack within 10 seconds deals bonus physical damage equal to 100% base AD (+40% bonus AD) and restores mana equal to 40% of the damage dealt. Cooldown: 1.5 seconds.

graph_edges.context: ER mana restore + Navori CD reset = infinite ability spam

items.name: Experimental Hexplate
items.passive: Hexcharged: After casting ultimate, gain bonus AS and MS.
items.passive_brief: After using ultimate, gain bonus AS + MS.
items.passive_full: Hexcharged: After casting your ultimate ability, gain bonus attack speed and movement speed for a short duration. Cooldown tied to ultimate usage.

graph_edges.context: Both reward ult usage — AS/MS on ult + ult CD reduction

items.name: Guardian Angel
items.passive: Resurrect: Upon death, revive with 50% HP and 30% mana after 4s stasis (210s CD).
items.passive_brief: On death, revive with 50% base HP. 210s CD.
items.passive_full: Resurrect: Upon taking lethal damage, become invulnerable and untargetable for 4 seconds, then revive with 50% base HP and 30% max mana. Cooldown: 210 seconds.

graph_edges.context: Zed can dive, get kill, die, revive safely
GA revive denies Rengar assassination value

items.name: Guinsoo's Rageblade
items.passive: Wrath: Every 3rd AA triggers on-hit effects twice. Converts crit to on-hit damage. Anti-synergy with Infinity Edge.
items.passive_brief: Every 3rd AA triggers on-hit effects twice. Converts crit to on-hit.
items.passive_full: Wrath: Every third auto-attack triggers all on-hit effects an additional time. Converts all critical strike chance into bonus on-hit damage (does not crit). Anti-synergy with Infinity Edge.

graph_edges.context: Guinsoo's converts crit to on-hit — IE crit bonus wasted
BotRK on-hit doubled every 3rd AA by Guinsoo's
Anti-synergy with infinity_edge — do not build together

items.name: Hullbreaker
items.passive: Set Sail: +5% MS. Skipper: Every 4th attack on champs/epic monsters deals 160% base AD (+5% max HP) bonus damage (240%+9% vs turrets). Boarding Party: Nearby siege/super minions gain bonus resists.
items.passive_brief: While alone in lane, gain armor/MR + empower nearby minions.
items.passive_full: Boarding Party: While there are no allied champions nearby, gain bonus armor and magic resistance and empower nearby siege and super minions, increasing their damage and resistances.

items.name: Infinity Edge
items.passive: Infinity: +30% crit damage. Limit Break: Every 1% crit exceeding 100% converts to 0.6% crit damage.
items.passive_brief: At 60%+ crit, gain bonus crit damage.
items.passive_full: Perfection: If you have 60% or more critical strike chance, your critical strikes deal bonus damage (total crit damage increased to 230%). Best as 3rd crit item when threshold is reached.

graph_edges.context: IE requires crits; Guinsoo's removes crits
IE + Navori = crit damage + crit CD resets
Anti-synergy with guinsoos_rageblade — do not build together

items.name: Kraken Slayer
items.passive: Bring It Down: Every 3rd AA deals bonus true damage.
items.passive_brief: Every 3rd attack deals bonus true damage.
items.passive_full: Bring It Down: Every third auto-attack deals bonus true damage. True damage ignores armor and magic resistance. Best vs tanky targets.

graph_edges.context: LT AS + Kraken true damage every 3rd = maximum tank shred

items.name: Lord Dominik's Regards
items.passive: Giant Slayer: Deal 0-20% bonus damage vs higher-HP targets.
items.passive_brief: Deal up to 20% bonus damage vs higher-HP targets. +30% Armor Pen.
items.passive_full: Giant Slayer: Deal 0-20% bonus physical damage to enemy champions based on HP difference (max bonus at 1000+ HP difference). +30% total armor penetration.

graph_edges.context: LDR + Cut Down = double HP-difference damage amplification

items.name: Magnetic Blaster
items.passive: Fervor: +5% MS. Power Blitz: Energized attacks gain 100 range, deal 40-100 bonus magic damage, grant 60 MS. Bounces to 5 nearby enemies, can crit.
items.passive_brief: Moving/attacking charges. At 100 stacks, next AA has bonus range + damage.
items.passive_full: Energized: Moving and attacking generate Energize stacks. At 100 stacks, your next auto-attack gains bonus range and deals bonus magic damage on hit.

graph_edges.context: Both use Energize stacking — synergistic charging

items.name: Manamune
items.passive: Awe: Gain AD from max mana. Mana Charge: Stacks mana. Transforms into Muramana.
items.passive_brief: Gain AD from max mana. Transforms into Muramana.
items.passive_full: Awe: Gain bonus AD equal to 2.5% of max mana. Mana Charge: Abilities and AAs grant bonus mana (stacking). At max stacks, transforms into Muramana with Shock passive (abilities/AAs spend mana to deal bonus damage).

graph_edges.context: Manamune transforms into Muramana at max mana stacks

items.name: Maw of Malmortius
items.passive: Lifeline: At 30% HP from magic damage, gain magic shield + omnivamp (90s CD). Limited to 1 Lifeline.
items.passive_brief: At low HP from magic damage, gain magic shield + omnivamp.
items.passive_full: Lifeline: When you take magic damage that would reduce you below 35% HP, gain a shield that absorbs magic damage for 5 seconds and gain bonus omnivamp. Cooldown: 90 seconds.

graph_edges.context: Lifeline passives don't stack — pick ONE
Anti-synergy with steraks_gage — do not build together
Anti-synergy with phantom_dancer — do not build together

items.name: Mortal Reminder
items.passive: Sepsis: Physical damage applies Grievous Wounds.
items.passive_brief: AAs apply 40% Grievous Wounds (60% below 50% HP). +30% Armor Pen.
items.passive_full: Sepsis: Auto-attacks apply 40% Grievous Wounds to enemy champions for 3 seconds. Enhanced to 60% Grievous Wounds on targets below 50% HP. Also provides 30% total armor penetration.

graph_edges.context: AA-applied GW cuts Soraka healing on every auto

items.name: Muramana
items.passive: Abilities and AAs spend mana to deal bonus damage.
items.passive_brief: Abilities and AAs spend mana to deal bonus damage.
items.passive_full: Shock: Auto-attacks consume 3% of current mana to deal bonus physical damage equal to 3.5% of max mana. Abilities that deal damage consume 3% of current mana to deal bonus physical damage equal to 4.5% of max mana. Transformed from Manamune at max mana stacks.

graph_edges.context: Muramana Shock + Trinity Spellblade = double on-hit burst

items.name: Navori Quickblades
items.passive: Transcendence: Crit strikes reduce non-ult ability CDs.
items.passive_brief: Critical strikes reduce non-ult ability CDs.
items.passive_full: Transcendence: Critical strikes reduce the remaining cooldown of your basic abilities (Q, W, E — not ultimate) by 15% of their total cooldown.

graph_edges.context: ER mana + Navori CD resets = infinite casts

items.name: Overlord's Bloodmail
items.passive: Tyranny: Gain AD based on bonus HP.
items.passive_brief: Gain AD based on missing HP.
items.passive_full: Bloodlust: Gain bonus attack damage based on your missing HP. The lower your HP, the more AD you gain. Provides massive raw HP with an offensive component at low health.

graph_edges.context: Low HP = more AD from Bloodmail + more damage from Last Stand

items.name: Phantom Dancer
items.passive: Spectral Waltz: Attacking grants ghosting + bonus AS. Lifeline: Shield at low HP (90s CD). Limited to 1 Lifeline.
items.passive_brief: At low HP, gain shield + bonus AS.
items.passive_full: Lifeline: When you take damage that would reduce you below 35% HP, gain a shield for 3 seconds and bonus attack speed. Cooldown: 90 seconds.

graph_edges.context: Anti-synergy with steraks_gage — do not build together
Anti-synergy with maw_of_malmortius — do not build together

items.name: Runaan's Hurricane
items.passive: Wind's Fury: AAs fire bolts at 2 nearby enemies with on-hit.
items.passive_brief: AAs fire bolts at 2 nearby enemies. On-hit applies.
items.passive_full: Wind's Fury: Auto-attacks fire additional bolts at up to 2 nearby enemies, each dealing reduced physical damage. Bolts apply on-hit effects. Best for AoE DPS in team fights.

graph_edges.context: BotRK on-hit applied to 2 extra targets via Hurricane bolts

items.name: Serpent's Fang
items.passive: Shield Reaver: Damage reduces enemy shields and new shield effectiveness for 3s.
items.passive_brief: Damage reduces enemy shields.
items.passive_full: Shield Reaver: Dealing damage to an enemy champion reduces any shields they have and reduces the effectiveness of new shields they receive for 3 seconds. Best vs heavy shield comps.

graph_edges.context: Shield Reaver reduces all shields including Ardent-triggered
Cuts Lulu shield + ult HP significantly
Reduces Karma RE team shield value

items.name: Serylda's Grudge
items.passive: Last Whisper: +33% Armor Pen. Icy: Ability damage slows 30% for 1s. Frostbite: 3 Icy stacks deal bonus damage + 50% Grievous Wounds (5s CD).
items.passive_brief: Abilities slow enemies by 30%. +30% Armor Pen.
items.passive_full: Bitter Cold: Damaging abilities slow enemy champions by 30% for 1 second. Also provides 30% total armor penetration. Best for ability-based AD champions who need armor shred + kiting utility.

graph_edges.context: Serylda's %pen + Cleaver shred = near-total armor removal

items.name: Soul Transfer
items.passive: On death, transfer stats to nearest allied champion.
items.passive_brief: On death, transfer stats to nearby ally.
items.passive_full: Soul Transfer: Upon death, transfer a portion of your stats to the nearest allied champion for a duration. Niche utility item.

items.name: Spear of Shojin
items.passive: Dragonforce: +20 basic ability haste. Focused Will: Damage to champs/monsters increases ability damage by 3% per stack (max 12%).
items.passive_brief: Non-ult abilities reduce ult CD.
items.passive_full: Dragonforce: Damaging enemy champions with non-ultimate abilities reduces your ultimate's remaining cooldown. Best for ult-reliant fighters.

graph_edges.context: Both reduce ult CD — double ult CD reduction

items.name: Sundered Sky
items.passive: Lightshield Strike: First AA on each champion crits and heals.
items.passive_brief: First AA on champion crits and heals.
items.passive_full: Lightshield Strike: The first auto-attack on each enemy champion critically strikes and heals you. Per-target cooldown. Provides both burst trading and sustain.

graph_edges.context: Conqueror stacking + Sundered Sky heal = sustained trading

items.name: Terminus
items.passive: Juxtaposition: AAs alternate Light (bonus resists) and Dark (bonus pen) stacks.
items.passive_brief: Alternate light/dark stacks granting resists or pen.
items.passive_full: Juxtaposition: Auto-attacks alternate between Light and Dark stacks. Light stacks grant bonus armor and magic resistance. Dark stacks grant bonus armor penetration and magic penetration. Provides both offensive and defensive stats through AA pattern.

graph_edges.context: Guinsoo's double on-hit + Terminus alternating stacks = maximum value

items.name: The Collector
items.passive: Death and Taxes: Execute below 5% HP + bonus gold on kill.
items.passive_brief: AAs execute below 5% HP + bonus gold on kill.
items.passive_full: Death and Taxes: Auto-attacks and abilities that damage enemy champions below 5% HP execute them (instant kill). Champion kills grant bonus gold. Synergizes with other execute effects.

graph_edges.context: DH below 50% + Collector 5% execute = layered execution

items.name: Titanic Hydra
items.passive: Cleave: AAs deal 2% max HP bonus damage in a cone. Active: Empowered AA.
items.passive_brief: AAs deal bonus damage based on max HP in a cone.
items.passive_full: Cleave: Auto-attacks deal bonus physical damage equal to 2% of your max HP to the target and nearby enemies in a cone. Active: Reset auto-attack with empowered cleave.

graph_edges.context: Heartsteel HP stacking + Titanic %HP damage = scaling synergy

items.name: Trinity Force
items.passive: Fervor: +5% MS. Spellblade: After ability, next AA deals 200% base AD (1.5s CD). Valor: AAs grant 20/10 MS for 2s. Limited to 1 Spellblade.
items.passive_brief: After ability, next AA deals 200% base AD. AAs grant stacking MS.
items.passive_full: Spellblade: After using an ability, your next auto-attack within 10 seconds deals bonus physical damage equal to 200% of your base AD. Cooldown: 1.5 seconds. Threefold Strike: Auto-attacks grant 25 bonus movement speed for 3 seconds, stacking up to 3 times.

graph_edges.context: Trinity + Sterak's = THE fighter core duo
Anti-synergy with divine_sunderer — do not build together
Anti-synergy with lich_bane — do not build together
Anti-synergy with essence_reaver — do not build together
Anti-synergy with iceborn_gauntlet — do not build together

items.name: Wit's End
items.passive: Fray: AAs deal 15-80 bonus magic damage on-hit (scales with level).
items.passive_brief: AAs deal bonus magic damage on-hit.
items.passive_full: Fray: Auto-attacks deal 15-80 bonus magic damage on-hit (scales with level). Also provides magic resistance for anti-mage dueling.

graph_edges.context: BotRK + Wit's End = double on-hit damage
50 MR reduces Brand magic damage significantly

items.name: Youmuu's Ghostblade
items.passive: Razor: +18 Armor Pen. Haunt: Active burst MS for 6s. Passive out-of-combat MS.
items.passive_brief: Active: burst MS. Passive: out-of-combat MS.
items.passive_full: Haunt (Active): Gain a large burst of movement speed for 6 seconds. Passive: Gain bonus movement speed while out of combat. Best for assassins who need to roam and engage.

graph_edges.context: Youmuu's MS + Duskblade stealth damage = roam assassin core

items.name: Archangel's Staff
items.passive: Awe: Gain AP from max mana. Mana Charge: Stacks mana. Transforms into Seraph's Embrace.
items.passive_brief: Gain AP from max mana. Transforms into Seraph's Embrace.
items.passive_full: Awe: Gain bonus AP equal to 1% of max mana. Mana Charge: Hitting champions with abilities grants bonus mana (stacking). At max stacks, transforms into Seraph's Embrace with active shield.

graph_edges.context: Transforms into Seraph's Embrace at max mana

items.name: Awakened Soulstealer
items.passive: Soul Hunt: Takedowns reduce all CDs by 25% + steal MS and AH.
items.passive_brief: Takedowns reduce all CDs by 25% + steal MS and AH.
items.passive_full: Soul Charge: Champion takedowns reduce all remaining ability cooldowns by 25% and steal movement speed and ability haste from the target for a duration.

graph_edges.context: Double ult CD reduction = ult available every fight

items.name: Bandle Fantasy
items.passive: Flameblossom: Damaging abilities spawn traps dealing magic damage.
items.passive_brief: Damaging abilities spawn traps under enemies.
items.passive_full: Damaging abilities spawn traps at the target location that activate after a delay, dealing magic damage to enemies who step on them.

items.name: Cosmic Drive
items.passive: Spelldance: 3 ability hits on champions within 3s grant bonus MS and AP for 4s.
items.passive_brief: 3 ability hits grant bonus MS and AP.
items.passive_full: Spelldance: Hitting enemy champions with 3 separate abilities within 3 seconds grants bonus movement speed and bonus AP for 4 seconds.

graph_edges.context: Phase Rush + Cosmic Drive = extreme kiting MS

items.name: Crown of the Shattered Queen
items.passive: Safeguard: First champion damage instance is significantly reduced (40s CD).
items.passive_brief: Damage reduction shield when first hit. 40s CD.
items.passive_full: Safeguard: While Safeguard is active, the first instance of champion damage you take is significantly reduced. Safeguard regenerates after 40 seconds of not taking champion damage.

graph_edges.context: Safeguard absorbs first instance of Zed burst

items.name: Horizon Focus
items.passive: Hypershot: Long-range abilities reveal and deal bonus damage.
items.passive_brief: Long-range ability reveals and deals bonus damage.
items.passive_full: Hypershot: Hitting an enemy champion with a non-targeted ability at long range reveals them and causes them to take bonus damage from all sources for a short duration.

graph_edges.context: Long-range ability + Comet + Horizon damage amp

items.name: Infinity Orb
items.passive: Destiny: Abilities crit against targets below 35% HP.
items.passive_brief: +15 Magic Pen. Abilities crit low-HP targets.
items.passive_full: Destiny: Gain 15 flat magic penetration. Abilities that damage enemy champions below 35% HP deal bonus damage (ability critical strike).

graph_edges.context: DH + Infinity Orb = double execute threshold
Deathcap AP + Orb magic pen = maximum burst

items.name: Liandry's Torment
items.passive: Torment: Abilities burn for max HP% magic damage over time.

items.name: Lich Bane
items.passive: Spellblade: After ability, next AA deals 75% base AD (+50% AP) magic damage (1.5s CD). Limited to 1 Spellblade.
items.passive_brief: After ability, next AA deals bonus magic damage.
items.passive_full: Spellblade: After using an ability, your next auto-attack within 10 seconds deals bonus magic damage equal to 75% base AD (+50% AP). Cooldown: 1.5 seconds.

graph_edges.context: Anti-synergy with trinity_force — do not build together
Anti-synergy with divine_sunderer — do not build together
Anti-synergy with essence_reaver — do not build together
Anti-synergy with iceborn_gauntlet — do not build together

items.name: Luden's Echo
items.passive: Echo: At 100 stacks, next ability deals bonus splash magic damage.
items.passive_brief: At 100 stacks, next ability deals bonus splash damage.
items.passive_full: Echo: Moving and casting abilities generates stacks. At 100 stacks, the next damaging ability deals bonus magic damage to the target and up to 3 nearby enemies.

graph_edges.context: Luden's splash + Electrocute = burst combo amplification
Luden's burst + Orb execute = kill threshold reached faster

items.name: Malignance
items.passive: Hatefog: Ultimate creates damage zone under nearby enemies.
items.passive_brief: Ult creates a damage zone under enemies.
items.passive_full: Hatefog: When you cast your ultimate ability, create a zone of magic damage under nearby enemy champions that persists for a duration.

graph_edges.context: Malignance zone + Axiom ult CDR = more ult zones

items.name: Mejai's Soulstealer
items.passive: Glory: Gain stacks on takedowns (lose on death). Stacks grant AP and MS. Max 25 stacks.

items.name: Morellonomicon
items.passive: Affliction: Magic damage applies 40% Grievous Wounds for 3s.
items.passive_brief: Magic damage applies 40% Grievous Wounds.
items.passive_full: Affliction: Dealing magic damage to enemy champions applies 40% Grievous Wounds for 3 seconds, reducing all healing received.

graph_edges.context: Magic damage GW cuts Aatrox sustain
AoE magic damage applies GW to entire team

items.name: Nashor's Tooth
items.passive: Icathian Bite: AAs deal 15 (+20% AP) bonus magic damage on-hit.
items.passive_brief: AAs deal bonus magic damage on-hit.
items.passive_full: Icathian Bite: Auto-attacks deal 15 (+20% AP) bonus magic damage on-hit. Best for AP champions who auto-attack frequently.

graph_edges.context: Nashor's on-hit + Riftmaker omnivamp = sustained AP DPS + sustain

items.name: Oceanid's Trident
items.passive: Surge: Abilities in combat deal bonus damage and grant heal/shield power.
items.passive_brief: Empowered abilities heal. Strong AP sustain.
items.passive_full: Empowered abilities provide healing based on damage dealt. Provides both damage and sustain for AP champions in extended fights.

graph_edges.context: Conqueror omnivamp + Oceanid healing = double sustain

items.name: Psychic Projector
items.passive: Active: Dash to target location (~40s CD). Provides mobility for immobile mages.
items.passive_brief: Active: Dash to target location.
items.passive_full: Active: Dash a short distance to the target location. Provides mobility for immobile mages and supports. Cooldown: ~40 seconds.

graph_edges.context: Karma gains mobility she lacks with Psychic Projector dash

items.name: Rabadon's Deathcap
items.passive: Unique: Increases total AP by 40%.
items.passive_brief: +40% total AP. THE core AP damage item.
items.passive_full: Passive: Increases your total ability power by 40%. The single most important AP damage item. Gold efficiency scales with total AP — terrible first item, best 2nd or 3rd item.

graph_edges.context: Orb + Deathcap = maximum AP for ability crits

items.name: Riftmaker
items.passive: Void Corruption: Damage stacks. At max stacks, deal bonus true damage. Grants omnivamp.
items.passive_brief: Dealing damage stacks bonus damage. At max, deal true damage.
items.passive_full: Void Corruption: Dealing damage to enemy champions generates stacks. Each stack increases your damage dealt. At maximum stacks, a portion of your damage is converted to true damage. Also grants omnivamp.

graph_edges.context: Conqueror + Riftmaker = double stacking sustained damage + omnivamp
Nashor's + Riftmaker = AP DPS + sustain + true damage

items.name: Rod of Ages
items.passive: Eternity: Stacks HP/Mana/AP per minute (max 10 stacks). Spending mana heals.
items.passive_brief: Stacks HP/Mana/AP every minute. Spending mana heals.
items.passive_full: Stacks: Gain bonus HP, mana, and AP every minute (max 10 stacks over 10 minutes). Eternity: Spending mana heals you. Taking damage restores mana. Best rushed first item for scaling.

graph_edges.context: RoA mana + Archangel mana-to-AP = scaling synergy

items.name: Rylai's Crystal Scepter
items.passive: Rimefrost: Abilities slow enemies by 30% for 1s.
items.passive_brief: Abilities slow enemies by 30%.
items.passive_full: Rimefrost: Damaging abilities slow enemy champions by 30% for 1 second. Provides kiting utility for all AP champions.

graph_edges.context: Rylai slow enables Cheap Shot true damage on every ability

items.name: Seraph's Embrace
items.passive: Awe: Gain AP from max mana. Lifeline: Active shield based on mana.
items.passive_brief: AP from mana. Active: Shield based on current mana.
items.passive_full: Awe: Gain bonus AP equal to 1% of max mana. Lifeline (Active): Consume mana to gain a shield for 2 seconds. Transformed from Archangel's Staff at max mana stacks.

graph_edges.context: RoA mana + Seraph's AP-from-mana = double scaling

items.name: Abyssal Mask
items.passive: Unmake: Reduce nearby enemies' MR. Gain MR per cursed enemy.
items.passive_brief: Reduce nearby enemies' MR. Gain bonus MR per enemy.
